_comment: Field names and select choices of the Airtable 'Institutions' table (tbl4V0FEbzRP7I2w2) and the 'Countries' table (tbltB7GSRoTtSi4Ps), read from the base's metadata API. bin/test-institution-application.php checks every field-name key the public application form uses against this list, and bin/test-fixtures.php checks that every stage the settings defaults name is one the base offers. The eight Agreement columns (Agreement Status, Agreement Kind, Agreement Accepted On, Agreement Signed On, Agreement Accepted By, Agreement Document, Agreement Submitted On, Agreement Template Version) were added to the base on 2026-09-02 for the Institutions module (design spec section 10), which is how 37 fields became 45. Two strings here are load-bearing and look like typos: 'Anything else you’d like us to know?' uses a right single quotation mark (U+2019) and not an apostrophe, and the first internship choice begins with a space. `create_records()` does not send `typecast`, so a choice spelled any other way is a 422 for the whole record. Refresh with a metadata read when either table changes.
